basic_info.description: Rarely available prime Noe Valley 6-unit building with TWO VACANT UNITS! Each unit is flex layout 2-3 bedrooms. Well-maintained, Excellent income opportunity for investors, with solid rents of the occupied units, and the vacant units offer excellent upside potential. A great option for an owner-user looking to live in Noe Valley! Partial seismic upgrades, new roof, and professional management in place. Several units feature in-unit laundry. Vacant units could rent for up to $6k/month for instant cash flow. Tons of value-add potential & storage. On the Sanchez Slow Street, within walking distance to cafes, restaurants, parks, and everything Noe Valley has to offer. Don't Miss!
